crossRefs.note: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and…
Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which…
He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
translations.bsb: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.
translations.kjv: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
translations.asv: And Moses let his father-in-law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
